frames.narration: The gallery is built with proxies. Each one knows only a filename. No disk read has happened.
The user opens photo b. The gallery calls display() on what it thinks is an image.
First use: the proxy creates the real, slow object now.
Then it forwards the call, so the client gets its picture.
The user opens b again. Same call from the client...
...and this time the proxy already has the real object, so it just forwards. No second load.
